description: This file provides a set of functions to perform CRUD operations on work items and comments through API calls, such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting resources. It acts as an API client module for a frontend application.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON (if any) or null. Throws on non-2xx responses.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON data; throws on error.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item via GET /work-items/{project_id}/{id}/comments.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item via POST /work-items/{project_id}/{id}/comments.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by projectId, via GET /work-items.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug) via POST /work-items.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a work item via PATCH /work-items/{project_id}/{id}/status.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs full URL for a given API path using the current base URL.

ctags.pattern: /^export async function addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null }) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
